card.title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S3 Screen shows flickering horizontal lines on screen repair

source.title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S3 Screen shows flickering horizontal lines on screen repair

claims.statement: Galaxy Tab S3 flickering lines are often the ST1_LCD_FPCB ribbon connection; clean and reseat both ends, or replace the connector.

procedure: Clean and reseat the ST1_LCD_FPCB ribbon.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
